walkthroughs.body_html: Nile supports 500 million across 11 countries. 1959 treaty allocated 100 percent to Egypt (55.5 bn m^3) and Sudan (18.5 bn). Ethiopia GERD (filled 2020-23) on Blue Nile (85 percent of flow); reduces Egyptian flow during fill. Egypt threatens military action; negotiations stalled.

China built 11 mainstream dams on Lancang (upper Mekong); 95 GW capacity. Downstream Cambodia, Vietnam suffer reduced sediment (-70 percent) and irregular flow. Vietnam Mekong Delta sinks 1-3 cm/yr; salt water intrusion threatens 50 percent of national rice supply.

Turkey's Southeastern Anatolia Project (GAP, since 1977) includes 22 dams. Ataturk Dam reservoir 817 km^2. Reduces Euphrates flow to Syria by 40 percent, to Iraq by 80 percent. Contributed to Syrian drought (2007-10) that preceded civil war.
